expectation: Membrane/cytoplasmic ring on neutrophils (small, often lobed nuclei), scattered as single cells or small groups in stroma and vessels and sometimes infiltrating tumour; some epithelial/tumour patches may stain diffusely. Neutrophils are uncommon to moderately common.
observed: A: discrete bright dots scattered across most tiles, denser in some, plus diffuse patches in a few tiles that look epithelial. B, C: many small separate cells with rings, on distinct cells among the nuclei, plus a diffuse streak in C. D: compact bright cells.
why: A clear population of discrete, small CD15+ cells scattered as single cells, as neutrophils should be, with tissue-patterned epithelial staining and little uniform haze.
notes: Many sharp, small CD15+ cells sit as scattered single cells or small groups across the tissue, consistent with neutrophils. Some tiles also show diffuse patches that look epithelial, which fits CD15's known epithelial expression.
